purpose: Metadata registry for external heritage damage datasets. This registry does not contain dataset binaries.

datasets.name: Brick Masonry Surface Damage Dataset Collected from Battledore of the Darbhanga Fort
datasets.annotationType: image-level damage categories with background images; source annotation details require local verification
datasets.intendedUse: First candidate for object-detection preparation after the files and annotation structure are locally verified.
datasets.notes: 7,440 damaged images and 446 background images; reported image size is 768 x 768. The background category is retained as source metadata and is not an object-detection class until annotation structure is verified.

datasets.name: MSD-Det: Masonry Structures Damage Detection Dataset for Preventive Conservation
datasets.intendedUse: Candidate object-detection dataset pending primary-source licence and access verification.
datasets.notes: Reported as 1,082 high-resolution images covering seven heritage masonry damage categories. Publication access does not by itself establish dataset redistribution rights.

datasets.name: YTU-CrackIS
datasets.intendedUse: Second-stage segmentation candidate after dataset-record licence verification and local inspection.
datasets.notes: Reported split is 1,904 training images and 469 validation images from UAV and handheld imagery of St. Theodore church, Cappadocia. GitHub project: https://github.com/TolgaBkm/CH_Crack_Detection

datasets.name: Heritage Cracks
datasets.intendedUse: Candidate crack-detection dataset pending verification of the actual dataset/source terms.
datasets.notes: Reported as 686 real field images and 1,030 augmented images of heritage buildings in Morelia, Mexico at 640 x 640. Images are not bundled or redistributed by this project.
